description.text: Note： a. We’ll start the visa application procedure for the students, after getting their application fees. b. Students should pay all the fees for their first year’s study within one week after their arrival. Nigerian students should wire all the fees for their first year’s study to my university before we send out the jw202 and admission notice. c. Students have to pay separately for the Internet connection in their room: 30RMB/month. d. Students have to pay separately for the electricity and water used in their room: depends on usage. e. Because of the limitation of quota of postgraduates, please remind the students to sign up as early as possible. f. Book fees are collected according to the true price.

duration.text: The Pharmaceutical Science at Jinzhou Medical University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3194 USD/per year ￥ 23000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of postgraduate school 5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 4or above 6. Two recommendation letters(optional) From professor,associate professor or equivalents. You can click here to download the sample 7.Photocopy of 1st page to 8th page of your valid passport (Liaoning) For the regarding authority must make sure that there are at least two pages on the passport for the Chinese Embassy to stick the Visa paper and Immigration to stick the resident permit paper

requirements.text: Applicant is under the age of 35, and is in good health, preferably with a Bachelor’s Degree or above. Certified academic records and 2 letters of recommendation by 2 associate professors are required. The HSK score should reach level 4 or above.
